findings.summary: On a duplicate-key retry the activity returns the fresh evaluation's summary rather than the stored record's, so the two can differ after an engine or rule-set deploy
Reason-code mapping is duplicated in apps/api/services/determinations.py:42 and can drift
members_for_year and application_form are tested only through fakes; real BSON decoding (Decimal128, datetime dates) is untested
